# Context & Landscape — Clinic Network Booking

## 1. Operating context
The network runs eight clinics. Booking today is a phone call to a clinic
reception desk during working hours; out-of-hours demand is unserved.

## 2. Systems in the landscape

| System | Direction / role | Constraint | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Specialists' external calendars | outbound — appointment events mirrored to the calendar the Specialist already keeps | the calendars stay in place; the product does not replace them | canvas: Third-Party Connections · call 2026-07-14 |

## 3. Adjacent initiatives
Online payment is a separate, later initiative (roadmap E-07).
